en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan Bin Yahy, from Shuayb, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Cut the thieving man after cutting the hand, then do not cut afterwards. So if he repeats, withhold him in the prison, and spend upon him from the public treasury of the Muslims’.
